finding: The CPython 3.12.14 library reference documents no PLY mesh reader. io and struct expose generic bytes or caller-specified layouts, not PLY elements, vertices, or faces. Tk PhotoImage documents image formats, not PLY meshes. There was no documented format-aware standard/runtime candidate to verify on the ASCII triangle control.
limit: Scoped to the CPython 3.12 library reference and the local 3.12.14 runtime; optional third-party system libraries and other Python distributions are outside this standard-library finding.
